attributes.summary: Audit-before-acceptance round 1: delegated via clink/codex (role exfu-auditor, sandbox read-only, model gpt-5.6-sol), 1 round, return salvage needed (preamble line). Verdict: revise — 1 high (no theme owned survey maths/extension seam), 5 medium (MCP-sibling overbreadth vs blindness, HITL branches contradicting ancestry, missing activation metric, T2/T3 detail leaking into T1, raw-data rule vs GDPR export), 1 low (unresolvable references). Full return: .exfu/returns/t1-top-level-audit-r1.json.

Draft revised addressing all 7 audit findings: T2-engine now owns both inflections + shared primitives + calculator extension contract; principle 3 scoped to public capabilities with privileged/raw-data exclusions; security surfaces assigned distinctly (authn=platform, authz/blindness=data-layer, agent credentials=agent-distribution); activation metric (completed two-party reconciliations) named in Success and principle 7; mechanism/inventory detail moved down to T2 altitude; raw-data rule restated as a disclosure boundary permitting data-subject access; background references given canonical paths and exact filenames; Q1/Q2/Q4 reworded to remove ancestry contradictions. Status remains draft — awaiting operator acceptance ceremony.
